# SwivelGrid

> A framework-agnostic data grid Web Component (`<swivel-grid>`) with a hook-based extension system. Renders data as a card grid or sortable table. No dependencies, no build step required.

- **npm:** https://www.npmjs.com/package/swivel-grid
- **Live demo / Bundle Builder:** https://swivelgrid.thanish.com
- **Full API Reference:** https://swivelgrid.thanish.com/API_REFERENCE.md
- **Architecture guide:** https://swivelgrid.thanish.com/ARCHITECTURE.md
- **Bundle system guide:** https://swivelgrid.thanish.com/BUNDLE_SYSTEM_GUIDE.md

---

## Install

**npm / yarn / pnpm**
```sh
npm install swivel-grid
```

**CDN — UMD (plain script tag, no module system)**
```html
<script src="https://unpkg.com/swivel-grid/dist/swivel-grid.umd.cjs"></script>
```

**CDN — ESM (type="module")**
```html
<script type="module">
  import { SwivelGrid } from 'https://unpkg.com/swivel-grid/dist/swivel-grid.esm.js';
  import { LayoutRendererExtension } from 'https://unpkg.com/swivel-grid/extensions/LayoutRendererExtension.js';
</script>
```

**Bundle Builder — single-file download (no package manager)**
Visit https://swivelgrid.thanish.com, pick the extensions you need, and download a ready-to-use `.js` file.
```html
<script type="module" src="./swivel-grid-custom.js"></script>
```

---

## Core usage pattern

```js
import { SwivelGrid } from 'swivel-grid';
import { LayoutRendererExtension } from 'swivel-grid/extensions/LayoutRendererExtension';
import { SortingExtension } from 'swivel-grid/extensions/SortingExtension';

// 1. Get the element
const grid = document.querySelector('swivel-grid');

// 2. Register extensions (order matters for priority)
grid.registerExtension(new LayoutRendererExtension()); // required — renders layout
grid.registerExtension(new SortingExtension());         // optional — adds column sort

// 3. Set schema (column definitions)
grid.schema = [
  { key: 'name',  label: 'Name',   sortable: true },
  { key: 'email', label: 'Email',  sortable: false },
  { key: 'score', label: 'Score',  sort: 'DESC' }
];

// 4. Set rows
grid.rows = [
  { name: 'Alice', email: 'alice@example.com', score: 95 },
  { name: 'Bob',   email: 'bob@example.com',   score: 82 }
];

// 5. Switch layout
grid.layoutType = 'table'; // 'grid' (default) or 'table'
```

HTML:
```html
<swivel-grid id="my-grid"></swivel-grid>
<script type="module" src="./app.js"></script>
```

---

## Extensions

| Name | Import path | Purpose |
|------|------------|---------|
| `LayoutRendererExtension` | `swivel-grid/extensions/LayoutRendererExtension` | **Required.** Renders table rows and grid cards. |
| `TemplateExtension` | `swivel-grid/extensions/TemplateExtension` | `{{value}}`-style cell/header templates with built-in helpers. |
| `SortingExtension` | `swivel-grid/extensions/SortingExtension` | Column sort on click, ASC/DESC, custom comparators. |
| `SearchExtension` | `swivel-grid/extensions/SearchExtension` | Binds an external `<input>` for live search/filter. |
| `PaginationExtension` | `swivel-grid/extensions/PaginationExtension` | Infinite scroll and page-based server data loading. |
| `CssClassesExtension` | `swivel-grid/extensions/CssClassesExtension` | Per-cell, per-header, per-row CSS class application. |
| `AccessibilityExtension` | `swivel-grid/extensions/AccessibilityExtension` | ARIA labels and keyboard navigation. |

All extensions extend `BaseExtension` from `swivel-grid/extensions/BaseExtension`.

### Extension management on the grid element

```js
grid.registerExtension(ext)                     // → boolean
grid.unregisterExtension('sorting')             // → boolean
grid.getExtension('sorting')                    // → BaseExtension | null
grid.hasExtension('sorting')                    // → boolean
grid.listExtensions()                           // → string[]
grid.swapExtension('sorting', newInstance)      // → boolean (hot-replace)
grid.toggleExtension('sorting', false)          // → boolean (disable without removing)
grid.toggleExtension('sorting', true, false)    // rerender=false skips render
```

---

## Schema column fields

Each object in `grid.schema` describes one column. `key` and `label` are required.

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `key` | `string` | Property name on each row object. **Required.** |
| `label` | `string` | Column header text. **Required.** |
| `sortable` | `boolean` | Whether clicking the header triggers sort. Default `true`. |
| `sort` | `'ASC' \| 'DESC'` | Initial sort direction. Only one column sorted at a time. |
| `sortComparator` | `Function` | Custom sort: `(a, b, rowA, rowB) => number`. |
| `cellTemplate` | `string` | Template for cell content. Use `{{value}}`, `{{row.field}}`, helpers. |
| `headerTemplate` | `string` | Template for header cell. Use `{{label}}`. |
| `cellClass` | `string \| Function` | CSS class(es) on the cell wrapper. Function: `(value, row) => string`. |
| `headerClass` | `string` | CSS class(es) on the `<th>`. |
| `className` | `string` | CSS class on the `<td>` element (table layout). |
| `columnClass` | `string` | CSS class on the whole column. |
| `minWidth` | `string` | CSS min-width, e.g. `'120px'`. |
| `maxWidth` | `string` | CSS max-width, e.g. `'300px'`. |
| `type` | `string` | **Deprecated.** Use `cellTemplate` instead. |

### cellTemplate helpers

```
{{value}}                    — raw cell value
{{row.fieldName}}            — another field from the same row
{{renderRating(value)}}      — star rating (supports "4/5", 4, { value:4, max:5 })
{{renderImage(value)}}       — <img> tag (supports URL string or { src, alt })
{{formatDate(value)}}        — formatted date
{{formatNumber(value)}}      — formatted number
{{formatCurrency(value)}}    — formatted currency
{{capitalize(value)}}        — capitalize first letter
{{truncate(value, 50)}}      — truncate to N characters
```

---

## Grid properties and data methods

```js
grid.schema = [...];                          // Array of SchemaColumn — triggers render
grid.rows = [...];                            // Array of row objects — triggers render
grid.layoutType = 'table';                    // 'grid' | 'table'
grid.searchInput = '#search-box';            // CSS selector — binds SearchExtension
grid.sortHandler = ({ key, direction }) => {}; // callback for server-side sort
grid.searchHandler = (query) => {};           // callback for server-side search

grid.setData(rows);                           // replace rows + reset pagination + render
grid.appendData(rows);                        // append rows without full re-render (PaginationExtension)
grid.setPageData(data, pageNumber?);          // replace rows for a given page (PaginationExtension)
grid.render();                                // force re-render
grid.destroy();                               // teardown all extensions and listeners
grid.getDOMElements();                        // → { tbody, gridContainer }
```

### Pagination properties (set after registering PaginationExtension)

```js
grid.pageSize = 20;
grid.totalPages = null;       // null = client-side only; number = server-side
grid.loading = false;
grid.loadMoreCallback = () => fetchNextPage();
```

---

## Bundle system

Load a curated set of extensions in one call instead of registering individually.

```js
import StandardBundle from 'swivel-grid/bundles/StandardBundle';
import AdvancedBundle from 'swivel-grid/bundles/AdvancedBundle';
import BundleBuilder   from 'swivel-grid/bundles/BundleBuilder';

// StandardBundle: LayoutRenderer + Templates + Sorting (~33-38 KB)
await StandardBundle.loadInto(grid);

// AdvancedBundle: all 7 extensions (~63-68 KB)
await AdvancedBundle.loadInto(grid);

// BundleBuilder: pick exactly what you need (deps auto-resolved)
const exts = new BundleBuilder()
  .addFeature('sorting')
  .addFeature('search')
  .build();
exts.forEach(ext => grid.registerExtension(ext));

// Presets: 'table-focused' | 'designer' | 'data-heavy' |
//          'minimal-interactive' | 'dashboard' | 'enterprise'
const exts2 = BundleBuilder.fromPreset('enterprise').build();
```

---

## Events

All events bubble and cross shadow DOM boundaries. Listen on the `<swivel-grid>` element.

| Event | Fired when | `event.detail` shape |
|-------|-----------|---------------------|
| `swivel:sort` | Column header clicked | `{ key: string, direction: 'ASC' \| 'DESC' }` |
| `swivel:search` | Search input changes | `{ query: string }` |
| `swivel:data` | `setData()` called | `{ rows: Array }` |
| `swivel:pageThreshold` | Scroll reaches 80% | `{ currentPage: number, visibleEndIndex: number }` |
| `swivel:pageDown` | Page decremented | `{ pageNumber: number }` |
| `swivel:pageUp` | Page incremented | `{ pageNumber: number }` |
| `swivel:virtualization-update` | Virtual scroll re-renders | `{ visibleRange: { start, end }, renderCount, lastRenderTime }` |

```js
grid.addEventListener('swivel:sort', e => {
  const { key, direction } = e.detail;
  fetchSortedData(key, direction).then(rows => grid.setData(rows));
});

grid.addEventListener('swivel:pageThreshold', e => {
  fetchNextPage().then(rows => grid.appendData(rows));
});
```

---

## Writing a custom extension

```js
import { BaseExtension } from 'swivel-grid/extensions/BaseExtension';

class MyExtension extends BaseExtension {
  constructor() {
    super('my-extension'); // unique name string
    this.priority = 60;    // lower = runs earlier; default 0
  }

  onInitialize(grid) {
    // called once when registered
  }

  onBeforeRender(context) {
    // context: { schema, rows, layoutType, searchInput, layoutHTML }
    // must return context (mutate or replace)
    return context;
  }

  onAfterRender(context, rootElement) {
    // DOM is live; rootElement is the shadow root
  }

  onDestroy() {
    // cleanup
  }
}

grid.registerExtension(new MyExtension());
```

---

## TypeScript

Type declarations are included in the package. No `@types/` install needed.

```ts
import { SwivelGrid } from 'swivel-grid';
import type { SchemaColumn } from 'swivel-grid/types';
import { SortingExtension } from 'swivel-grid/extensions/SortingExtension';

const grid = document.querySelector<SwivelGrid>('swivel-grid')!;
const schema: SchemaColumn[] = [
  { key: 'name', label: 'Name', sortable: true }
];
grid.schema = schema;
grid.registerExtension(new SortingExtension());
```

---

## JSON Schema for column definitions

A JSON Schema for `SchemaColumn` is available for IDE validation and agent code generation:

```
https://unpkg.com/swivel-grid/schema-column.schema.json
```

---

## Styling

Override CSS custom properties on the element:

```css
swivel-grid {
  --primary-color: #007acc;
  --border-color:  #e1e5e9;
  --hover-color:   #f8f9fa;
  --text-color:    #24292f;
  --star-color:    #fbbf24;
}
```

The scroll area has a fixed `max-height` of 600px (400px under 768px wide).
